rateLimits.note: Open Topo Data's public API: "Max 1 call per second" (opentopodata.org, Public API).
Open Topo Data's public API: "Max 1000 calls per day".

provenance.notes: Read on opentopodata.org (2026-11-10): public API free, no key, max 100 locations per request, 1 call per second, 1000 calls per day; beyond that, self-host the open-source server or use the paid GPXZ hosting. No terms of use and no licence stated on the page: each dataset links to its producer (USGS, NASA, NOAA, GEBCO, EEA, BKG, LINZ...), whose own licence and credit apply (SRTM public domain; EU-DEM Copernicus; GEBCO...): rights left unknown. No rate-limit headers seen on a test call. Contact e-mail hidden behind e-mail protection on the page.
